balls.text: Zak ends the innings with a wicket. That's full and straight and strikes Christian on the back pad. He looks to run a scrambled single but Zak is already celebrating.
full again, gets it away through the covers and Chipli will not face the last ball
driven down to long off
gets under that and slices over point, Chipli not stopping here

great catch Virat Kohli. Duminy gives that an almighty thwack over mid-wicket and it looks likes it destined to go all the way. Kohli is on the fence and leaps up to grab that. Birthday boy gone for 22.
Zak bowls the last over. Yorker length and dug out to the off side.
scoops it over short  fine leg and that spoils what was a good few balls from van der Wath. 180 on the cards for Deccan
Duminy swinging again but that's a slower ball and he's misread it.
full again and Duminy can't get it away. Trying to force it out and on the off side but it's too good for him
full and widish, Duminy doesn't move to the ball and has a swing at it but misses
in the spot, good ball and Duminy digs it out and sends it over long on. He made room out of nowhere to hit that
full and straight and carved away through the covers
and again, Duminy hitting it well, without any real force or anger, good timing and the overthrow allows them the second
played to deep mid-wicket
over long off, poses some problems for the fielder there, who is just about to snatch it out of the air, but finds himself on the rope and Umpire Koertzen calls it six immediately
on legstump and Duminy tries to flick it away but misses
wristily played into the on-side Chipli oozing confidence here
Chipli only had to wait one more ball for it, driven to long off and there's his 50
struck powerfully to point and the man with the number 14 on his shirt gets down and fields superbly to cut off a certain four
driven on the up, through the covers, pierces the gap but finds the fielder on the rope
steered to point and things calm down a little
full toss and driven uppishly through the covers. Four off the first three balls of this over
beautiful ball, on the toes and Chipli has luck going his way. Inside edge down to fine leg
Zak's back and he's gone too wide with that slower one. Chipli knocks it back over his head, couple of bouces and four.
run fine to backward square leg, great over for the Chargers, seems its acceleration time
down to long off, Duminy happy to give Chipli the strike
Dilshan comes round the wicket and Chipli plays to mid wicket for one
And again. Down on the knee quicker, teasing the fielder again, but this time it's flatter and it's the same result
Chipli! That didn't look like it was going over but it did. Pulls high and it's over mid-wicket
nicely timed, square of th wicket for one
turned onto the leg-side, Duminy off the mark and keeps strike
Duminy faces his first ball on his birthday, steers it to point, yells "Wait" loudly

full and wide from van der Wath. Sanga a litte unsure, tries to drive, hits the ball and the ground in the same stroke. None of that puts de Villiers off and he takes the catch cleanly. Small pause from Sanga but he's off as soon as he is given out
more in line this time, makes contact and drives off the front foot, through the gap in the covers
Not moving his feet  to the ball at all is Chipli. Tries to cut again, but swings and misses
Chipli makes some room, looks to cut but gets an inside edge. Luckily, that didn't end up on his stumps
works with the angle this time, down to long-on
goes straight again, but just not enough to reach the rope
dead straight again. Sanga is getting his maximums in the classiest fashion. Over Dilshan's head and that's high and into the stands
just short of a length, Chipli also on the back foot, can't get hold ot if, single to long on
on the back foot, swings it to long on
nudged to mid off, brings up the 100
sensibly turned to mid-wicket, excellent strike rotation in that over
whipped through mid-wicket, off the pads
turned to mid-wicket
lofted higher and into the gap. Chipli steps forward and strikes it over mid-wicket.
lofts it up, stays in the air for a little while and rolls to long on
smacked into the on-side, enough time for one
pushed past Dilshan to mid on, ambled single
tapped into the off side
not too short from Dilshan but Chipli is rooted in his crease wih the back foot, swivels and sends it over mid-wicket
flicks it to mid-wicket
Sanga makes some room but can't get away
pushed to long on
on the back foot, nudged to mid-on
big stride in and defends into the covers
played to mid-off
Sanga goes over Ninan's head, hit dead straight and high and that's a top shot. Full toss from Ninan, given the treatment
pushed to long-off
played straight back to the bowler, he lets it trickle away, but the batsmen won't risk a second
deft touch to square leg, that was just drifting on the pads
Vettori building pressure here driven straight to extra cover
pushed to long-on
tossed up and the batsman can't get it past Vettori
defended down the ground
driven down to mid-off
Same shot, hit further and he's out. On one knee, Sohal lofting it to long-on. Twiwary is on his haunches and pouches it safely
Sohal wanting a big shot again, on one knee tries to give it the heave-ho, but gets it as far as the inner ring
turned to fine leg
that's the first six of the innings. Too short from Ninan, hoicked over mid-wicket, classy shot
looks to whip away on the on-side, doesn't get enough on it, rolls away
offspinner, driven to long-off, thoughts of a second, turned down
good strike rotation, played to mid-wicket
steers it to short third man
finds the gap, Snaga opens the face and guides it to third man, pretty shot
pushed to the mid-wicket area
steered to third man, Sanga charges down but is sent back by Sohal
delicately turned on the leg side
goes for the hoick on the on-side, Steyn says he is like a right-handed Sanath Jayasuriya as he plays that
good shot, over the covers, stand and delivert stuff. Sohal still giving himself some space but that was full enough to hit
straying on the leg side, Sohal looks to sweep, misses and the extra ball has to be bowled
that's quite quick. Cuts through Sohal, good delivery
Nice and wristy from Sanga, finds short fine leg
turned around for an easy one
pushed into the covers
another misfield and this time they pay for it. Extra cover makes a hash of it. It was a low full toss and Sanga got hold of it well
nicely placed to mid-wicket
down the leg-side, looks for a booming sweep and strikes, short-fine eg misfields but keeps it down to one
scampered single, clipped onto the on-side
gives himself space to smack that into the covers. Dilshan would have had to dive far forward to catch it, but gathers well
Sohal still trying to make room, defends back to Dan
looks for a cute little sweep but judges it wrong and the ball deflects off the pad for a leg-bye
defended back to the bowler
tries to whip it to fine leg, AB does well to gather that
goes the aerial route, over mid-wicket. Sohal's wristwork is quite effective, turns that well
turned to the on-side. Zak labours to the ball and let's them run two
nicely struck to Vettori at mid-on who fumbles
Tries to make room to cut and misses again
one bounce and four. Still a touch too short from van der Wath, Sohal doesn't try to hit it on the off side this time and cracks it to long on
better from van der Wath, Sohal tries to hit over cover but swings and misses
Doesn't cost much, Sohal misses it completely.
another no-ball from van der Wath, really struggling with his rythym. He was just on the line there, line belongs to the umpire
nicely worked into the mid-wicket area, cool and calm from Sanga
Sangakkara's first ball, defended back to the bowler
another good ball, Sohal has no room to do much other than defend. Successful over for Zak

Dhawan holes out. It's a good ball from Khan, better line and length, but Dhawan plays a silly shot. Looking to go over the top but mis-times. It goes high and Vettori gets under it at mid-on to give Bangalore their early breakthrough. He had to back pedal a little, and fell over while taking it, but held on
Sohal is tucked up, gets it away on the on side and runs a quick first one, thinks of a second, decides not to
wide and cut away. That was there to be hit and Sohal smashed it
played to mid-on, quick single taken
turned around to mid-wicket, not enough on it to get past the fielder
better from van der Wath, squares Sohal up, tighter ball to end an over that went for 11
Sohal makes room, tries to cut that away but he's gone too far and can't get to it.
another confident drive, this time into the covers and some good fielding saves that going all the way
that is gorgeous, driven straight past the bowler for four. van der Wath not finding the right length, overpitched again.
driven well to the extra cover fielder
van der Wath tries to bowl the yorket but it's pushed into the gap and gets to the boundary
and now it's a no-ball, this is a disappointing start for van der Wath
van der Wath starts with a wide, far outside off
clipped to square leg, tidy start from RCB
hits the back pad and cleaned up by the keeper
now it really is too wide, Sohal wants to cut but can't reach
full again and driven to mid-on
whipped through mid-wicket, excellent fielding keeps it down to one but could easily have been more
That's too wide from Zak, giving Sohal room outside off and he cuts to third man
full delivery, gets it on Sohal's toes, turned nicely to square leg
played into the covers and that's a 33-run win for the Chargers. The Hyderabad jinx has been broken - the Chargers win their first match at home. Bangalore lose their second in succession.
full again, Christian bowling a good over at the end
driven to long on
slower ball again, full and Vettori inside edges onto the pad
slower ball, yorker, dug out for one
and again, wide down the leg side this time
wide outside off, called that way
short ball, Ninan goes for the pull, gets the edge and Sanga takes his fifth catch of the night. Hyderabad jinx no more I think.
Vettori backs away far, Steyn sends it wide of offstump and there's no run. They're going to need more than a Herschelle Gibbs six sixes here. The last over could well be a formality
pushed into the covers
full toss, Ninan ducks under it, falls on his backside as the ball whizzes past his ear. Steyn immediately apologies, no-ball is called
swings and misses
slower ball, flicked down to deep square leg
edged down to third man.
Steyn on a hat-trick. Big appeal for lbw, but strikes Vettori on the pads outside off and they ran through for the leg-bye.
off the hips, Vettori steps outside the off stump and send that to fine leg
dab into the covers, Ninan off the mark

It's over. Gony ges for a big hit over mid-wicket but misreads the delivery. It's a slower ball and it goes on to hit off stump. Th big man is gone, he kicks the ground in frustration as he leaves. This is a big ask for Bangalore now.
Full toss and smacked! bashed! He's got that many, many rows back, over long on and that's a huge one
Kohli makes big room for himself, drive in the air to long off. Ankit was there and has been marshalling his boundary well all night but can't get to that.
driven to long on, good running and they get two
but none of that tonight. Beaten for pace, van der Wath gets an outside edge and Sanga takes another catch. The Steyn remover has made the difference here
yorker length, Pujara wants to go over the top but doesn't get his feet moving at all, goes straight to Christian at extra cover
straighter and very full. Pujara cuts that away, excellent timing and it's got away. Bangalore giving themselves a real chance
Steyn hurls down another wide one, that's hit square of the wicket and well get down to two by Dhawan
wide ball, this time Pujara takes advantage, sends it through the covers
swings away, Pujara swings and misses
pulled to long on - and it's TIme Out time again. We've got a busy last four overs coming up. 68 runs needed to win. Can Bangalore thump it or will the Chargers win at home at last?
full toss, one handed swipe to long-off
legbreak, Kohli dances down the wicket and smashes that over long-on. He's taking them on now
driven to long on, Kohli loses a boot in the process of completing the first run, gets two
big heave-ho from Kohli over mid-wicket, the fielder almost dives into the advertising boards but it doesn't matter, six it is
played into the covers
deft cut past Sanga and it's a boundary for Pujara
into the covers for one
too full to pull that one but Pujara tries it anyway. It goes high and Christian comes around from mid-off to try to take it but can't get there in time
slower ball and played away to mid-on
wide outside off, Kohli has a swipe and misses
Gony's back and that one is pulled to long-on. Good fielding down on the boundary
into the covers
legbreak, short and  hoicked up to mid-wicket. Dhawan comes in to get it but it bounces well in front of him
legbreak, scooped out to the covers, Christian collects on the bounce
googly, played away to mid-wicket, Mishra chases it all the way there and has a shy at the stumps but Kohli is safe
chipped to mid-wicket
wonderful shot by Pujara. That's what we've been looking forward to seeing. Back over the bowlrs head and it's a great four
overpitches, wide and mowed through the covers
full and whipped away to long-on. Great fielding by the man there, dives to make a save, saves two
short ball, pulled away to deep mid-wicket
full, slower ball, Kohli moves in front of the stumps and is struck on the pads, big appeal, turned down
driven to mid off, Gony fields well has a shy at the stumps but Pujara would have been home
full and driven to long on. Yorker length from Dan Christian but Kohli's not too scared of that
on leg stump, dug out to long off
full and inviting and smashed over cover. One bounce four. That's the first costly free hit we've had today, I think
Mishra overstepps this time, that's slapped away into the covers
defended back to Mishra
what a rude welcome for Pujara that previous ball, turns this one away and gets off strike
googly, turns back into Pujara, who doens't pick it, hits him on the back pad and it's done too much, missing leg
too much pressure and Tiwary had to go for a big one. Tries to hit that with the turn and gets a top edge that goes straight up. Sanga gets below it takes safely. Bangalore folding.
flicked to mid-wicket, picks out the fielder and can't get a run. Pressure squarely on RCB now
short again, inside edged onto the pitch, doesn't get far at all
good line, pushed on the on side
short ball and Tiwary swings at it, gets it to long on
sliced drive past point, in the air for a while, Sharms does some great work on the boundary and saves two
short ball, cross-batted swipe and Tiwary misses
goes straight through Kohli, who was looking to sweep, the ball goes past the inside edge and the keeper takes the bails off but his foot didn't leave the crease
straight delivery, pushed to mid off
cut again, this time to deep point
topspinner, Kohli tries to cut, gets it to third man boundary off an edge
legbreak, driven to cover boundary, fumbled and there's two there
Mishra on, slapped to extra cover, Duminy fields that well
played off the legs, quick and easy run. Time-Out time. phew!
pushed into the covers, it's got some timing on it, beats the inner ring and there's two on offer
tapped down just on the on side, they scramble through, good intent to get that single
dabbed down to mid-off
driven out into the covers, a little looser from Christian, allows Tiwary some room
good line and length again, from Dan Christian this time, Tiwary defends
great delivery, holds it line and beats the bat. The required run rate steadily climbing and I am hearing songs from Dabanng being played at the ground
touch shorter and fended off to fine leg
Full and straight, defended solidly

bouncer, hit in the air and falls safe in the mid-wicket region. Ashutosh comments on the speed Sharma is bowling, "Has any one bothered to notice the speed at which Ishant Sharma is bowling, his fastest is at 152.2Kmph and he's averaging at almost 150kmph."
wider ball, cut away, beats Duminy at point and then tests the fielder that's run around to third man, he saves it at first and then it bobbles onto the rope
straighter ball, flicked through mid-wicket, lots of space down there to run a few
another good ball, gets it away for one. Deccan on top, all the bowlers have performed well so far
Saurabh Tiwary and his flowing locks face their first ball. Pushed into the gap on the off side and he sets off for the run immediately

goner! Gony has been bowling a superb line so far and this time he is rewarded. de Villiers gets a thick outside edge and Sanga does the rest. Big, big wicket for Deccan, de Villiers goes without scoring and the Hyderabad curse is slowly being broken
good line, not giving de Villiers any space to play anything other than a forward defensive
played down to third-man
stikes Kohli on the back pad and there's a big appeal from Gony but it looks too high and replays show that it is
good line and it's pushed into the off side. Sharma being coached by Steyn throughout this over and it's obviously worked
short again, de Villiers is looking to play a pull but can only manage a little dab back to Sharma
pushed away to the covers, can't pierce the ring, Sharma bowling well
just a touch shorter, keeps low and de Villiers and is surprised by the lack of bounce this time, plays and misses
AB de Villiers faces his first ball, plays a confident drive to point, JP Duminy pounces on it
steered to third man, past the widish second slip, who gets down but can't stop one

Manpreet Gony ends a good in superb fashion. It's a touch shorter, rushes onto Agarwal, who is looking to hit everything out of the park. He hoicks it up to mid-on where Amit Mishra has all the time in the world to get under it. Bangalore in real trouble now.
not as much bounce this time, steered down to third man
extra bounce, Agarwal gives himself some space, hits the ball over the point area, good control
Sid Mallya looks extremely stressed on the sidelines as Agarwal swivels and pulls into the vacant mid-wicket region.
good length again, straight delivery and nudged onto the on side
Manpreet Gony comes on, immediately hits a good length and it's banged into the pitch, doesn't get far
guided down to third man, just a little shorter from Sharma, gives Kohli some time to play it away
full again and driven by Kohli. Sharma gets down well in his follow through to his field
nice and full from Sharma and Kohli can only dab it back to him
defended to the covers
Leading edge to extra cover and it's just one
Agarwal throws his bat at it, gets it over third man and I have never heard a commentator so surprised to see a four, which he thinks is a six at first
That did not work for Bangalore at all. Zak makes a bit of room, full toss from Steyn and it hits middle. Great sight for the world's best bowler, accurate as always.
full, swinging away and Zak doesn't move much. Tries to grasp for it late but can't get there
Well, well, we have Zak here in a pinchitting role. He is looking to smash, but misses the first one.
Comes off the bottom of the bat and it's just cost one
Steyn oversteps and it's driven through the covers for a couple
no footwork again, tries to smash it somewhere but the ball is moving too much for Agarwal
goes aerial over the covers, finally connects with one from Steyn and connects well
Hyderabad erupts! The Sri Lankan danger man is gone, caught behind by his compatriot. Sharma bowls it on a length, Dilshan gets a fine edge and Sanga makes no mistake
thick edge off the toe of the bat, past the man at gully
chops it down to third man, good, hard running gets them two
Can't get it away cleanly, bounces off the ground on the off side
More bounce, Dilshan can't do anything with that and Sanga collects high again
Sharma shares the opening bowling duties. Bounce on offer for him there, Dishan reaches it for it and Sanga collects behind
swings in this time, whipped away behind square on the leg side, good start from Steyn
Dilshan has a heave-ho. Mistimes it to mid-on, looking to go aerial but can't get enough on it
gets bat to ball, steers it loosely to third man, Bangalore's chase has begun
swings away, Steyn getting good movement and Agarwal is lost. No clue how to play that
wide outside off and Agarwal has a big swing, misses
Driven off the front foot, well fielded at point, Steyn starts with a good line
